svg.desc: ScadaCraft OpenBridge widget: Badge (count) (obc-badge, OpenBridge 1.0.0, Apache-2.0). Library: OpenBridge · Alerts and status. Box 48x48 px, anchor at (0,0). Bindable properties: _pn_number (default 0, read): Number shown _ps_type (default 'alarm', read): Type: alarm | warning | caution | running | notification | regular | automation _ps_size (default 'large', read): Size: regular | large _pb_hideZero (default true, read): Hide the badge when the number is 0
